selects.note: The console commit this publication SELECTS (unchanged from the prior pin — the console page was not touched by this republish). The published page compares this against its own CONSOLE_SOURCE_COMMIT to render its currency verdict.

purpose: Adds /semantic-abi/ — the interactive Semantic ABI demo (trustless-ai/semantic-abi, ETHOnline 2026 from-scratch track) — to the org site, restyled to the trustless-ai brand (light palette, embedded Space Grotesk + Inter). Two files changed vs the prior tree: the new semantic-abi/index.html and the site growth already carried on main. The console page and its currency wiring are unchanged.

availability.note: build/site_cid.py derives the CID with `ipfs add -n`, which STORES NOTHING — and on this publish that trap actually fired: the contenthash was set to the derived CID before any node held the bytes, and every gateway 504'd (a pointer to nothing). Fixed by running the real `ipfs add` (no -n) with the recorded params on the committed tree; it reproduced this exact CID, proving the bytes are recomputable AND placing+pinning them on a live announcing node. Then pinned on Pinata by hash (pinByHash id 44cbe943-06bc-47bd-aebe-eac710a1d92c), not re-uploaded, so the service replicates THIS CID rather than minting its own.

retrieval_verified.method: HTTP GET of <cid>/semantic-abi/index.html, checked for the restyle marker; a 200 with the marker on an independent gateway means the bytes are reachable, not that they were compared byte-for-byte (no check_served_bytes.py run on this record).

verification.note: Read back via ENS after the owner (0xFf9a…ca14) set the contenthash; it decodes to this CID. The setContenthash tx hash is not yet recorded here — `tx` below is empty pending it.

discipline_note: HONEST DEVIATION: this was a UNILATERAL pin. The README rule is 'no pin until two independent parties each rebuild the stated commit and reproduce the same CID/tree hash', and the recommended order is record-then-transaction. Neither held here: the owner set the contenthash first (under ETHOnline time pressure), and only one party (this node) has rebuilt and reproduced the CID so far. `confirmations` is empty on purpose rather than backfilled. A second node reproducing `tree_sha256`/`cid` from trustless-ai-landing@f5dbcb1 should append its signed confirmation, and `tx` should be filled with the setContenthash transaction hash, to bring this record up to the standard the rest of the file assumes.
